title: Connect Azure AD to GitHub
content:
Connect Azure AD to GitHub

Follow the instructions on this page to install the SaaS app (Enterprise application) for GitHub to Azure AD and configure according to documentation. Do no enable automatic provisioning of accounts we’ll assume people brings their own GitHub account.

Figure: After GitHub application has been added to AD and Team synchronization enabled.

Figure: GitHub enterprise app and overview page of management and settings

Figure: Configuration of SSO

Connect GitHub organization to Azure AD

Connect GitHub Enterprise cloud organization to Azure AD is done on the security settings page for the organization. Links to detailed documentation is available on page

Two-factor authentication should be checked as mandatory. If we use existing inter-ikea organisation this requirement should not be checked until existing users has had the chance to activate two-factor authentication.

SAML single sign-on must be enabled. If we use existing inter-ikea organisation “Require SAML SSO authentication for all members of the ipex-test organization” should not be checked to allow existing users to link their account.

Team synchronization should be enabled.

User management

Users are created using the same process as today via help desk. Is it possible to distribute creation of accounts? For uses that should have a domain account this created and for users that are external developers that need access to GitHub are created as guest users using mail for GitHub account.

Figure: Domain an guest users are created in AD

Team groups are created in AD for contributors and for read only users. A couple of persons in the team e.g. product owner are med owner of group and can add users to group.

The contributor group is added to GitHub enterprise app on creation.

Figure: AD Group is added to GitHub Enterprise app to enable synchronization.

When user has been added to GitHub in Azure AD and log in to GitHub and access organization next time he can link account to Azure AD.

When account is linked user is added to group they are automatically added to corresponding team. When account is removed from AD access to GitHub organization is revoked.

Figure: User is removed from AD

All teams are added as children to the IPEX team.

Figure: Nested teams

IPEX Administrator(s) have team maintainer privileges on IPEX team and created new team assign the and link it to pertinent AD Group.

Figure: A team is linked to corresponding by GitHub admin
